scripts.asbuild:lisp: npx -y --package assemblyscript asc --config ../lisp/asconfig.json ../lisp/assembly/index.ts -o lisp.wasm --target release --use getchar=../lisp/assembly/host/getchar --use putchar=../lisp/assembly/host/putchar
scripts.asbuild:lisp-wasi: npx -y --package assemblyscript asc --config ../lisp/asconfig.json ../lisp/assembly/wasi.ts -o lisp-wasi.wasm --target wasi --use getchar=../lisp/assembly/wasiHost/getchar --use putchar=../lisp/assembly/wasiHost/putchar
scripts.asbuild:TinyBasic: npx -y --package assemblyscript asc --config ../TinyBasic/asconfig.json ../TinyBasic/assembly/index.ts -o TinyBasic.wasm --target release --use ScreenChar=../TinyBasic/assembly/host/ScreenChar --use KeyInChar=../TinyBasic/assembly/host/KeyInChar --use OutStr=../TinyBasic/assembly/host/OutStr
